FILE Q&A IN THE ASSISTANT, CHAT PANELS & PREVIEW (v3.0.4+)
---------------------------------------------------------------
  Ask questions about the open file in the AI Assistant (Ctrl+Alt+A).
  Python (ConsumerRAG / FastTextRAG) runs in the background, so
  even GB+ files (e.g. a 3.6 GB TXT) open quickly; semantic indexing is opt-in.
  Cancel loading no longer freezes the UI: the Python plugin
  (ConsumerRAG.exe) is stopped in the background.
  Mouse wheel (and Ctrl+wheel) over the Assistant or Script sidebar
  scrolls that transcript, not the main list.
  Read (Ctrl+1 / toolbar): with a file already open it opens the file
  browser and loads the chosen file immediately.
  Compare / merge preview and session history show correct accents
  (UTF-8 / ANSI / UTF-16 auto-detected; session log stored as UTF-8).

Ctrl+Alt+A toggles the FastFile AI Assistant (v3.0.5.254). Natural-language ops + compose: generate Word/RTF/DOCX/ODT/PDF summaries and source (.py/.js/.ts/.go/.java/...). Files go to fastfile_assistant\ (not fastfile_temp). Clear/Copy reply buttons. Safety lock blocks malware, disk format, OS shell, and dangerous extensions. count_matching_lines counts contains/partial matches locally (AI-first). Ask to open the Nth Recent Files entry. Local tools when possible (filter+export, replace, split). Ctrl+L opens the docked FilterBar (MRU 20). Status bar Mode/Wrap/Tail/Filter click toggles. SQL and file-content questions stay in the Assistant (Ctrl+Alt+A); Python engines run in the background. With focus in the panel: Ctrl+H/L/F, Ctrl+Shift+L/Q, Ctrl+Z/Y, Ctrl+C/V. UI languages: 14 (incl. Japanese, Chinese Simplified/Traditional). Optional startup (ASkin.ini: AssistantShowOnStartup). AssistantLog=1 appends Assistant.log.

TOOLS / SESSION / OPTIONS (menu reorg v2.1.7.29+)
---------------------------------------------------------------
  Tools > Filter and analysis:
    - View > Character Code Value: Unicode U+, decimal, UTF-8 bytes,
      byte offset for one character on the current line (no full scan).
    - Extract Frequent Strings: MMF scan; lines / words / CSV cells;
      bucket spill when file > 8 MB; CSV output; progress GB | MB/s | ETA.
    - Delete Duplicate Lines: keeps first occurrence; whole line or CSV
      column key; on-disk chained hash set; temp file + rename;
      disk-space check before write.
  Session: read-only session toggle; save/load session file.
  Options: segmented heavy-ops policy only (moved from old flat Options).

IDLE WORKSPACE BRAND (v3.0.2+)
---------------------------------------------------------------
  When no document tab is visible, the central workspace shows a soft
  blue gradient with the FastFile logo, a large watermark behind it,
  and centered title, tagline, and copyright text.
  Uses high-resolution PNG (1200+ px); Lanczos scaling and a paint
  cache keep circular arcs smooth without a startup rectangle flash.
  Position stays fixed when opening or closing the AI assistant panel.
  See DOC_IDLE_LOGO_WORKSPACE.md in the source folder.

READ PANEL — COLUMN BLOCK & AUTOFILL (v3.0.2+)
---------------------------------------------------------------
  Content column (column 2): Ctrl or Alt + drag = vertical block
    selection; width matches your drag (copy with Ctrl+C).
  F11 with an active block selection: extend to full content width;
  F11 alone (no block): toggle full-screen view.
  Line # column: drag down without Ctrl/Alt = autofill blank rows
    (live preview; CSV mode inserts delimiter-only rows).
  Checkbox list: same Ctrl/Alt block rules in the text area.

---------------------------------------------------------------
  Ctrl+F: docked Find Occurrences bar — F3 / Shift+F3, paged clickable hit list, Load more.
  Ctrl+B: docked Bookmarks bar — jump, Prev/Next, remove, clear all, Export/Copy.
  Tabs: drag and drop to reorder (order saved in the INI).
  Options: MRU sizes, line-hint delay/limits and history excerpt size.
  Line endings CR+LF / LF / CR supported in all routines; EOL and encoding conversion.
  Line editor: Ctrl+F / Ctrl+H find & replace, F3 next, F4 / Shift+F4 replace / replace all,
    Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo/redo, Ctrl+Shift+Del clear, Alt+Up / Alt+Down previous/next line,
    Ctrl+Shift+A Ask AI, Ctrl+Enter confirm, Esc cancel.
  Session history (Ctrl+Shift+H): checkboxes + Select all + delete, sort by line or date,
    date range From/To (Esc clears), export TXT/CSV, Ask AI, export by legend,
    paged RAM-safe preview for huge files.
  Diff between two files: synced scrolling; fast, cancellable apply left <-> right.
  Assistant: "What next?" chips after each operation; continues where you left off.
  Stability: global exception guard + UI hang / memory watchdog.

RECENT FEATURES (v3.0.5.226 – v3.0.5.232)
---------------------------------------------------------------
  AI agent on files (Ctrl+Alt+G): pick files/folders, describe the request, review the answer.
    Nothing is written before Accept; Accept / Reject / Accept all within the time limit
    (default 20 s, Options > Preferences). It counts, searches, reads, edits/inserts/deletes lines,
    anonymizes and runs FastFile actions (replace all, split, export, filter...).
    SQL or plain words in the 14 languages: SELECT / GROUP BY / SUM on CSV; UPDATE / DELETE / INSERT
    become proposals. "not partial" / "exact" = whole word.
    Each area has its own bar (new, clear, copy, ask AI); buttons are enabled only when there is content.
  Generated files: window to open the file, open the folder or copy the path; "Last generated file" reopens it.
  Anonymize (Ctrl+Alt+D or whole file): fake data of the same type and length; preview; undo.
  Session history: double-click an event = full lines before/after, fields, export TXT/CSV/JSON.
  Custom PPI on the toolbar: UI scale while running, synced with the status bar zoom.

---------------------------------------------------------------
  Fast line edit (from 32 MB): insert, replace and delete via the line index
    (in place, shift or rewrite). A recovery log restores the file if the app stops mid-edit.
  Before saving selected lines, a before/after list shows only what changes.
  Line editor — Extract: digits, e-mails, dates, columns, CPF or your own regex.
  Python: a short preview (ok / skip / error) before the full run.
  Win64: parallel line index from 128 MB, with bounded memory.
  Source check: JSON, HTML and SQL inside FastFile; Java, Go and C# with the
    compiler already on this PC. "Source code with AI" explains generate, validate and fix.
  AI agent: profiles each file, understands which files you named (14 languages)
    and can run a Python macro on each line (preview; the original file stays).
  Folder picker: several folders from different places.

Automatic fix after a failed validation|Click "Fix with AI": the AI receives the file and the errors, the corrected file is saved over it (FastFile asks first if it is outside the fastfile_assistant folder) and it is validated again.|
Change the last generated file|Ask for changes in the question box; the AI rewrites the last generated file.|fix the generated file: add error handling
C# (.cs)|Classes, records, interfaces and services.|create a C# class BankAccount with Deposit and Withdraw methods

SQL, JSON, HTML, Markdown, TXT|Scripts, configuration files, pages and texts. Write the extension (.sql, .json, .html, .md, .txt) in the request.|generate a .sql script that creates the customers table with id, name and e-mail
Documents: PDF, DOCX, ODT, RTF (Word)|Summaries and reports, also from the open file.|summarize the open file in PDF
Go (.go)|Packages, structs and functions.|write a Go program (.go) that counts the lines of a text file
Java (.java)|Classes, interfaces and enums. One public class per file, with the same name as the file.|create a Java class Product with name and price, getters and setters
JavaScript (.js)|Classes, functions and Node.js scripts. Say "JavaScript" or ".js".|create a JavaScript function that validates an e-mail address
C / C++, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Kotlin, Swift|Generated the same way (.cpp, .c, .rs, .php, .rb, .kt, .swift), but not validated yet.|write a C++ function that reverses a string
Delphi / Pascal (.pas, .dpr, .inc)|Units, classes, procedures and functions.|create a Delphi unit with a function that formats a phone number

TypeScript / Angular (.ts)|Interfaces, types, classes and services. Say "TypeScript", "Angular" or ".ts".|create a TypeScript interface Customer and a class CustomerService with add and find methods

RECENT UPDATES (v3.0.5.255 – v3.0.5.261)
---------------------------------------------------------------
  The interface now has 22 languages, including Hindi, Russian, Korean,
    Dutch, Turkish and Ukrainian. Hindi uses a left-to-right layout.
  Equal-parts processing reads memory-mapped chunks without loading
    the whole file; the split tab stays open when it finishes.
  After reading a file, the next-steps guide suggests useful actions.
    Reopen it in Preferences or turn it off there.
  The editing context menu and session-history wording were localized.
  The guide and Preferences were redesigned; the guide initializes
    without flicker or interrupting file reading.

RECENT UPDATES (v3.0.5.262 – v3.0.5.265)
---------------------------------------------------------------
  Thai, Greek, Norwegian, Swedish, Danish and Icelandic bring
    the interface to 28 languages. All six read left to right.
  Next steps follow the current activity, such as find, filter,
    split, merge or read, instead of one fixed list.
  Each activity offers more follow-up actions.
  A button to the left of Copy reopens the next-steps guide.

RECENT UPDATES (v3.0.5.266 – v3.0.5.268)
---------------------------------------------------------------
  The next-steps guide is shorter, so the file list stays visible.
  A Read icon sits inside the file path field, left of the clear X.
  It uses the same glyph as Read on the toolbar and loads that path.
